title: Manoj v. State of U.P.
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Vipin Chandra Dixit, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; petitioner directed to file Rule 6.5 objection.
headnote: Writ in an electricity dispute disposed of by directing the petitioner to file an application/objection under Rule 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; if filed within two weeks, the concerned authority to decide after hearing within two months.
facts: Manoj invoked the writ jurisdiction of the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and two others in an electricity supply dispute. Counsel for the petitioner and for the distribution-licensee respondents were heard. The order does not record the underlying billing or connection controversy. The Division Bench disposed of the petition by relegating the petitioner to an application/objection under Rule 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: A writ petition raising an electricity grievance may be disposed of by directing the petitioner to file an application/objection under Rule 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; if filed within two weeks, the concerned authority shall decide it after granting an opportunity of hearing, completing the exercise within two months.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's electricity grievance
not_decided.note: Writ disposed of by relegating the petitioner to a Rule 6.5 application/objection without adjudicating the underlying dispute.
